item.title: Hezbollah rejects renewed ceasefire agreed by Israel and Lebanon
item.description: The United States announced the ceasefire agreement on Wednesday night following a fresh round of talks.

item.title: Astronauts return to ISS after sheltering during air leak repair attempt
item.description: Russian attempt to repair tunnel area sparks safe-haven procedure for five other astronauts onboard.

item.title: US and Iran exchange strikes in Gulf in latest test of ceasefire
item.description: The US military says it struck Iranian drones and radar sites. Tehran responds by targeting US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain.

item.title: Palestinian baby killed by Israeli gunfire in West Bank, health ministry says
item.description: The Israeli military says Friday's "incident is under review", expressing "deep sorrow for any harm caused".

item.title: Iran's football team granted visas to enter US for World Cup, officials say
item.description: The approval comes just 10 days before the Iranian squad's opening match against New Zealand in Los Angeles.

item.title: Putin says there is 'no point' meeting Zelensky over ending Ukraine war
item.description: The Russian president's refusal comes after his Ukrainian counterpart wrote an open letter calling for face-to-face talks.

item.title: Armenia braces for election as Russia piles pressure on pro-West government
item.description: Incumbent Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan is seeking a third term despite falling domestic support.
